svg.aria-label: A heatmap and two timelines. The heatmap has twelve rows, six placements of one 113 KB client dependency times two bundlers, and 53 columns, the prerendered pages grouped into 15 pages outside the sections, 19 sec0 pages and 19 sec1 pages. Solid cells mark pages whose first-load JS contains the dependency: none for v0 and v3; only /sec0/p1 for v1 and v4; all 19 sec0 pages for v2; /sec0/p1 and /sec1/p1 for v5; identical for Turbopack and webpack. Dark hatched cells mark measured prefetch downloads: /sec0/p0 for v1, v4 and v5, and /sec1/p0 for v2 and v5. Pale hatched cells mark pages that, by the same links, would prefetch it: the other sec0 pages for v1 and v4, every non-error page outside sec0 for v2, and the other pages of both sections for v5. In v3 the target page fetches it only when the toggle is clicked. Below, two timelines for a click from /sec0/p0 to /sec0/p1 in v1 under Turbopack. With prefetch on, the page load fetches the route tree and page segment, whose import row makes preloadModule download the 55,806-byte chunk, and the click costs 0 requests. With prefetch blocked, the load costs 9 requests and 141,148 bytes, and the click fetches 1,604 bytes of RSC and then the 55,806-byte chunk.
